systems.owner: communes, under the joint oversight of the ministries of territorial administration and of justice
systems.tiers: a civil-status centre in every urban commune, rural commune and commune d'arrondissement, with secondary centres where a commune creates them

note: The civil-status law: it allows the registration and keeping of civil-status acts at commune centres to be manual and/or computerised, with equal legal value (Article 15), and describes paper five-part registers sent up by hand; a law, stating nothing on any commune office's connection or equipment.
